name: Metropolitan Cathedral of San Salvador
scope: The standing Metropolitan Cathedral on Plaza Gerardo Barrios, including its twin open belfries, deep central arch, nave, transepts and crossing dome.
era: Standing post-2011 cathedral, shown by the 2018 canonization exterior photographs and the present cathedral historical account.

externalReferences.artist: Presidencia de El Salvador from San Salvador, El Salvador, América Central

originalReview.notes: The original oblique photograph shows the belfry paired openings facing the square, openings around their side returns, low cupolas, tall narrow nave windows and the profile of the main crossing dome.

externalReferences.artist: Presidencia de El Salvador from San Salvador, El Salvador, América Central

originalReview.notes: The original near-frontal photograph shows the deep square-facing arch, round window, stacked central entry, statue niche and paired bell openings on the twin towers. Event light colors and projections do not inform the permanent finishes.

review.method: Qualla gallery first, then exact same-event Presidency CC0 exterior originals with paired rights records
review.notes: The exact Qualla CC0 photos show the procession. The additional front and side photographs were released CC0 by the same Salvadoran presidency account at the same event. Their native originals match Commons and both contemporaneous Flickr transfers have passed CC0 reviews.
